errors.evidence: Description states 46% for 'Nahrungs- und Genussmittel' when it is about 37% in the figure.
Description states approximately 10% for 'Bergbau' and 11% for 'Baugewerbe', while the figure shows around 7% for 'Bergbau' and 8% for 'Baugewerbe'.
The description fails to mention the purpose of the chart regarding the impact of minimum wage increase on sectors and business sizes.
The description does not specify that the bars for categories of business size are positioned after a gap, while they are presented separately from the industries.
